articles.title: The Quest For Caffeine You Can Have At Night
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 夜间咖啡因替代品中，paraxanthine 因安全性最高而成为最佳选择，尽管它对部分人无效。
paragraphs: 追求 5 点喝咖啡 10 点入睡，有三种思路：增强代谢酶 CYP1A2、直接使用代谢物 paraxanthine、或用短效类似物 methylliberine。rutaecarpine 虽能三倍提升酶活性，但可能伤肝。
paraxanthine 是咖啡因 80% 的代谢产物，人体已有暴露，安全性最强。用户报告约 2/3 有效，半衰期约 3 小时，但约 1/3 无效，可能与个体代谢差异有关。
methylliberine 半衰期仅 1.5 小时，但评价五五开，且抑制 CYP1A2 会延长后续咖啡因作用。作者最终推荐 paraxanthine，剂量 50-200mg，而 rutaecarpine 因肝损伤风险仅建议紧急使用。

en.thesis: Among nighttime caffeine alternatives, paraxanthine stands out as the best choice due to its highest safety profile, despite being ineffective for some users.
paragraphs: For those seeking the impossible—coffee at 5 p.m. and sleep by 10 p.m.—there are three main strategies: boost the activity of the metabolic enzyme CYP1A2, directly use the caffeine metabolite paraxanthine, or opt for a short-acting analog like methylliberine. While rutaecarpine can triple enzyme activity, it carries a risk of liver damage.

Paraxanthine, which constitutes about 80% of caffeine's metabolites, is already present in the human body, making it the safest option. User reports indicate it works for roughly two-thirds of people, with a half-life of about three hours, but about a third find it ineffective, possibly due to individual metabolic differences.

Methylliberine has an even shorter half-life of just 1.5 hours, but user reviews are evenly split, and it inhibits CYP1A2, which could prolong the effects of subsequent caffeine. Ultimately, the author recommends paraxanthine at a dose of 50–200 mg, while rutaecarpine should be reserved only for emergencies given its liver toxicity risk.

articles.title: Town's CEO on the self-organizing company
articles.author: Casey Newton

zh.thesis: AI 智能体将自我组织的知识库带给小公司，但必须先解决隐私与信任问题才能普及。
paragraphs: Town 公司推出名为 Townie 的 AI 助手，连接日历和邮件后，能在90秒内生成用户档案，并自动构建个人维基，成本每位用户约100美元。用户对此反应热烈，称其为「关系」而非产品。
公司计划推出团队版维基，自动汇总各成员的资料，但隐私风险极高，如不慎泄露薪资。CEO  Greze 认为，五年后可通过专门训练的模型执行隐私策略，但小公司会先采用，因信任度高且风险可控。
Greze 强调 AI 是「最接近生命的东西」，但拒绝将其视为独立经济主体。他预测 AI 目前只处理知识工作者10-20%的繁琐工作，要广泛改变工作还需多年，正如智能手机普及花了十年。

en.thesis: AI agents will bring self-organizing knowledge bases to small businesses, but privacy and trust issues must be solved first before they become widespread.
paragraphs: Town's AI assistant, Townie, connects to calendars and email to generate a user profile in 90 seconds and automatically build a personal wiki, costing about $100 per user. Users have reacted enthusiastically, calling it a 'relationship' rather than a product.

The company plans to launch a team version of the wiki that automatically aggregates members' profiles, but privacy risks are high, such as accidental leaks of salary information. CEO Greze believes that in five years, specially trained models could enforce privacy policies, but small companies will adopt it first due to high trust and manageable risk.

Greze emphasizes that AI is 'the closest thing to life' but refuses to treat it as an independent economic agent. He predicts that AI currently handles only 10-20% of knowledge workers' tedious tasks, and widespread change in work will take years, just as smartphones took a decade to become ubiquitous.

zh.thesis: 内存控制器的地址变换层并不安全，能直接被打穿，进而解锁CPU最隐秘的固件区域。
paragraphs: 现代CPU的内存访问经过层层抽象，虚拟地址最终要经过内存控制器的DRAM重映射。安全机制如SMM、PSP都依赖这些映射来隔离内存。
研究者通过逆向AMD Family 16h的内存控制器，利用其可编程的地址混淆寄存器，制造别名使受保护的物理地址可被读写。结果成功提取了PSP的RSA代码和SMM入口，甚至能修改CPU微码。

en.thesis: The address translation layer in the memory controller is not secure: it can be directly broken through, unlocking the CPU's most concealed firmware regions.
paragraphs: Modern CPUs route memory access through layers of abstraction, with virtual addresses ultimately passing through the DRAM remapping logic in the memory controller. Security mechanisms like SMM and PSP rely on these mappings to isolate memory.

Researchers reverse-engineered the memory controller of AMD Family 16h, exploiting its programmable address scrambling registers to create aliases that make protected physical addresses readable and writable. As a result, they successfully extracted the PSP's RSA code and the SMM entry point, and could even modify CPU microcode.

articles.title: My very interesting Conversation with Daron Acemoglu
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 左翼自由主义因自身掌权方式的失误而衰落，重振需从个体自由出发，而非预设更高价值。
paragraphs: 在与考恩的对话中，阿西莫格鲁为自由主义辩护，指出其衰落源于左翼精英未能善用体制权力，而非单纯外部威胁。他类比罗马衰亡，强调内部缺陷招致外部攻击，如同当下西方民主的困境。
他否认存在绝对真理或功利主义等外部标准，认为道德演进如科学，需逐步共识。他提出非支配概念，兼顾免于干涉与机会实现，以对抗强权，并警告自动化和AI若不受约束，难促普遍繁荣。
对话触及教育衰落、教师工会改革、社交媒体监管与生育率等问题，反映其将自由主义、经济学与技术关切交织的立场。他的立场开放，承认无完美答案，但坚持自由作为起点，为民主未来提供反思。

en.thesis: Left-liberalism's decline stems from its own failures in wielding institutional power, and its revival must begin from individual freedom rather than presuming higher values.
paragraphs: In his conversation with Cowen, Acemoglu defends liberalism, arguing that its decline is due to left-wing elites' failure to use institutional power wisely, not merely to external threats. He draws an analogy to the fall of Rome, suggesting that internal weaknesses invite external attacks, much like the current predicament of Western democracies.

He denies the existence of absolute truths or external standards like utilitarianism, viewing moral evolution as similar to science, requiring gradual consensus. He proposes the concept of non-domination, which balances freedom from interference with the realization of opportunities, as a counter to authoritarian power, and warns that automation and AI, if unconstrained, will not promote widespread prosperity.

The conversation touches on the decline of education, teacher union reform, social media regulation, and fertility rates, reflecting his intertwined stance on liberalism, economics, and technology. His position is open-ended, acknowledging no perfect answers, but insists on freedom as a starting point, offering reflection on the future of democracy.

articles.title: 3 myths about coding with AI that even experienced developers still believe
articles.author: Abhinav Raj

zh.thesis: AI 编程的三大迷思——提升生产力、改善代码审查、仅是自动补全——各有偏差，真实影响比叙事更复杂。
paragraphs: 奥克兰大学研究显示，82% 的开发者写代码时间减少，但工作转向验证和纠错，认知负荷加重，体验变差者从 14% 升至 27%。
多伦多都会大学测试发现，GitHub Copilot 常漏报 SQL 注入等关键漏洞，却关注风格问题，人工审计仍不可缺。
但现代 agentic 工具远超自动补全：Claude Opus 4.6 自主重写 1.6 万行生物信息工具，通过 2001 项测试，耗时或达人类数周。

en.thesis: Three myths about AI coding—boosting productivity, improving code review, and being mere autocomplete—are each misleading, and the real impact is more complex than the narrative suggests.
paragraphs: Research from the University of Auckland shows that 82% of developers spend less time writing code, but their work shifts to verification and error correction, increasing cognitive load; the proportion reporting a worse experience rose from 14% to 27%.
Tests at Toronto Metropolitan University found that GitHub Copilot often misses critical vulnerabilities like SQL injection while focusing on style issues, so human review remains indispensable.
However, modern agentic tools go far beyond autocomplete: Claude Opus 4.6 autonomously rewrote a 16,000-line bioinformatics tool, passing 2,001 tests, a task that could take humans weeks.

articles.title: 科技爱好者周刊（第 408 期）：你需要知道的 AI 缓存知识

zh.thesis: AI缓存命中可大幅降低输入成本，但需留意时效和激活费用。
paragraphs: 大模型按Token收费，但缓存命中的输入价格可低至未命中的五十分之一，如DeepSeek V4 Flash仅2分钱。原因是缓存直接复用已算结果，几乎不耗算力。
但缓存有时效，Anthropic为5分钟，DeepSeek和OpenAI约10分钟，Google一小时。超时未用则删除，重新计算恢复原价。AI工具为保缓存，常每30秒发请求，但费用不低，建议改4分钟。

en.thesis: AI cache hits can drastically cut input costs, but you need to watch out for expiration times and activation fees.
paragraphs: Large models charge by token, but the input price for a cache hit can be as low as one-fiftieth of the uncached price. For example, DeepSeek V4 Flash costs only 2 fen. The reason is that a cached result is reused directly, consuming almost no compute.

However, caches have an expiration time: Anthropic's is 5 minutes, DeepSeek and OpenAI's are around 10 minutes, and Google's is an hour. If not used within that time, the cache is deleted, and recomputing brings back the original price. To keep caches warm, AI tools often send requests every 30 seconds, but that's not cheap—it's better to set the interval to 4 minutes.

articles.title: The Foothills Of Bay Area House Party
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 硅谷的怪诞被当成常态，但每条荒诞都藏着一个真实的趋势。
paragraphs: 文章以讽刺笔法描绘湾区派对：从“关键答案禁令”到“后识字”言论，映射AI时代的信息恐慌与社交异化。派对上各色人物皆成时代缩影。
Epstein名单招聘、PornHub的意识证明、AI腔调社交，这些桥段看似夸张，实则直指科技圈对伦理的实用主义态度。Tran模仿AI口吻后约会频繁，揭示人类偏好已被AI重塑。
最终“基准答案”触发群氓暴力，暗喻科技圈对真相的恐惧。玩笑背后，是对AI影响下人性与社会的冷峻观察，讽刺中带着真实忧虑。

en.thesis: Silicon Valley's absurdities are treated as normal, but behind each absurdity lies a real trend.
paragraphs: The article paints a satirical portrait of a Bay Area party, from a 'key answer ban' to talk of a 'post-literate' era, mirroring the information panic and social alienation of the AI age. Every character at the party becomes a microcosm of the times.

The Epstein list recruiting, PornHub's proof of consciousness, and AI-flavored socializing may seem exaggerated, but they point directly to the tech world's pragmatic attitude toward ethics. Tran, after mimicking AI speech patterns, starts dating more frequently, revealing that human preferences have already been reshaped by AI.

The eventual 'benchmark answer' triggers mob violence, a metaphor for the tech circle's fear of truth. Beneath the jokes lies a cold-eyed observation of how AI is affecting humanity and society, with satire carrying genuine concern.

zh.thesis: DeepSeek Harness 将智能体一切能力插件化，并以不可变日志追踪每次运行，展示AI基础设施的新方向。
paragraphs: DeepSeek 发布 Harness 开发者预览，核心是「一切皆插件」：模型、工具、技能、会话、存储等全部可替换组合，基于 Cordis 插件系统。开发者无需改动源码即可定制，体现了灵活性与模块化。
每个运行都记录在追加式会话日志，包含系统提示、推理过程、工具调用等，支持查看、恢复、分支与重放。这提升了可追溯性与调试能力，对复杂智能体尤为重要。
提供标准、代码、最小和创建者四种模式，适应不同场景，如基准测试最小环境。开源 MIT 协议，但仍是预览，API 会演进。虽属发布公告，但设计思路值得注意。

en.thesis: DeepSeek Harness turns every capability of an agent into a pluggable component and logs every run immutably, pointing to a new direction for AI infrastructure.
paragraphs: DeepSeek has released a developer preview of Harness, built around the principle that everything is a plugin: models, tools, skills, sessions, storage, and more can be swapped and combined freely, powered by the Cordis plugin system. Developers can customize without touching the source code, highlighting flexibility and modularity.

Every run is recorded in an append-only session log, including system prompts, reasoning traces, tool calls, and more, with support for viewing, resuming, branching, and replaying. This enhances traceability and debugging, especially important for complex agents.

Four modes—standard, code, minimal, and creator—cater to different scenarios, such as a minimal environment for benchmarking. It is open-sourced under the MIT license, but still a preview, so the API will evolve. Although this is an announcement, the design philosophy is noteworthy.

articles.title: Medicare for All should be more like Medicare
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 民主党的全民医保政策应模仿现有美国医保制度，而非加拿大模式，才能赢得选民。
paragraphs: 「全民医保」口号吸引人，因为医保项目广受好评，且公众在原则上支持医疗不应由市场决定。但口号不等于具体政策，需要设计可行方案。
作者指出，现行左翼提案多参照加拿大模式，但更明智的做法是让该政策更像美国现有制度，因为那正是选民熟知且支持的。具体细节待付费阅读。

en.thesis: The Democratic Party's Medicare for All policy should mimic the existing American Medicare system rather than the Canadian model to win over voters.
paragraphs: The slogan 'Medicare for All' is appealing because Medicare is widely well-regarded, and the public supports in principle the idea that healthcare should not be determined by the market. But a slogan is not a concrete policy; a feasible plan needs to be designed.

The author points out that current left-wing proposals often follow the Canadian model, but a wiser approach would be to make the policy more like the existing American system, since that is what voters know and support. Specific details await paid reading.

zh.thesis: 《独自打保龄》的预言大多成真，但其对电视的归因被低估。
paragraphs: 重读此书，作者发现当年争议性的预测——教会衰落、互联网无法替代线下社交——都已被证实。电视导致社交资本下降的说法，虽篇幅少却关键。
合作者质疑其因果链，并认为反自由主义思潮有害。两人都同意，书中对电视作用的分析不足，而这在流媒体时代尤为切题。

en.thesis: Most of the predictions in 'Bowling Alone' have come true, but its attribution of decline to television was underestimated.
paragraphs: Rereading the book, the author finds that its once-controversial predictions—the decline of churches and the inability of the internet to replace in-person socializing—have all been confirmed. The claim that television caused the drop in social capital, though brief, was crucial.

Co-authors question the causal chain and argue that anti-liberal thinking is harmful. Both agree that the book's analysis of television's role was insufficient, which is especially pertinent in the age of streaming media.

zh.thesis: 旧式服务业岗位不仅存在，还在以出人意料的方式复苏。
paragraphs: 在德里，有人靠模仿长尾叶猴的尖叫声来驱赶恒河猴，这份工作成了正式职业，因为猴群肆虐，而唯一有效的威慑就是这种声音。
为迎接羽毛球世锦赛，德里雇用这些口技专家，他们一边模仿猴叫一边巡逻，让猕猴不敢靠近。这反映出即使在高科技时代，传统技巧依然有市场。

en.thesis: Old-style service jobs are not only surviving; they are making an unexpected comeback.
paragraphs: In Delhi, a job that involves mimicking the shrill calls of the langur monkey to scare away rhesus macaques has become an official profession, because the monkeys are causing havoc and the only effective deterrent is this sound.

To prepare for the badminton world championships, Delhi hired these vocal mimicry experts, who patrol while imitating monkey calls to keep the macaques at bay. This reflects that even in the high-tech age, traditional skills still have a market.

articles.title: Google recommends these 7 NotebookLM prompts, and they showed me what I was missing
articles.author: Mahnoor Faisal

zh.thesis: Google推荐的7个NotebookLM提示词，展示了它从资料整理工具向主动执行分析任务的转变。
paragraphs: 作者试用了Google官方推荐的NotebookLM提示词，发现其新能力可自动生成难度递增的测验、格式化PDF学习指南，并直接从课程大纲添加URL。这简化了学生创建学习材料的流程，但作者对更新方向仍有保留。
商业提示词如计算各产品线营收增长并绘图，或读取营销简报后联网搜索竞品并提出建议，标志着NotebookLM从被动问答转向主动分析，甚至能运行代码处理数据。个人场景则可将收据自动转为费用追踪表，或分析房产购买并建立预测模型。
这些示例表明NotebookLM的演变：上传的资料不再只是查询对象，而是生成最终产物的原料。作者虽不赞同所有新方向，但认为提示词揭示了Google的意图——让AI完成端到端的任务，而非仅提供信息。

en.thesis: Google's recommended NotebookLM prompts reveal its shift from a mere research organizer to an active task executor.
paragraphs: The author tried Google's officially recommended NotebookLM prompts and discovered new capabilities that automatically generate quizzes of increasing difficulty, format PDF study guides, and add URLs directly from course syllabi. This simplifies the process of creating study materials for students, but the author still has reservations about the direction of the update.

Business prompts, such as calculating revenue growth for each product line and plotting it, or reading a marketing brief and then searching the web for competitor insights and suggesting actions, mark NotebookLM's transition from passive Q&A to proactive analysis, even running code to process data. In personal scenarios, it can turn receipts into an expense tracker automatically or analyze a property purchase and build a predictive model.

These examples indicate NotebookLM's evolution: uploaded materials are no longer just objects to query but raw ingredients for generating final outputs. The author doesn't agree with all new directions but believes the prompts reveal Google's intent—to have AI complete end-to-end tasks rather than just provide information.

zh.thesis: 在科技行业，坚持信念而非随大流，才是真正的竞争优势。
paragraphs: 文章批评科技圈千篇一律的策略，主张以个人信念为指引，而非追随共识。作者称这种人为「异端」，认为他们才能突围。
以星巴克为例，说明其成功源于对咖啡文化的坚持，而非模仿竞争对手。但内容多为付费订阅，具体论证不足，更像励志宣言。

en.thesis: In the tech industry, staying true to your convictions rather than following the crowd is the real competitive advantage.
paragraphs: The article criticizes the industry's tendency toward cookie-cutter strategies and argues for guiding decisions by personal conviction rather than group consensus. It calls such people 'heretics' and contends that they are the ones who break through.

Using Starbucks as an example, it shows how the company's success came from sticking to its coffee culture rather than imitating rivals. However, much of the content sits behind a paywall, and the specific arguments are thin, reading more like an inspirational manifesto.

zh.thesis: 超快推理将消除速度与智能的权衡，开启新的应用可能。
paragraphs: Cerebras与OpenAI合作推出GPT-5.6 Sol的Ultrafast模式，每秒输出750个token，且无质量损失。其硬件采用晶圆级引擎，在芯片上集成44GB SRAM，减少数据搬运，突破了GPU的内存瓶颈。
基准测试显示，完成人类最后考试（HLE）全部2500题，Ultrafast仅用11小时，而Claude Fable 5耗时78小时，速度快约7倍。在GDP-Val经济价值任务上，端到端提速5.6倍，且质量不变。

en.thesis: Ultrafast inference will eliminate the trade-off between speed and intelligence, opening up new application possibilities.
paragraphs: Cerebras, in partnership with OpenAI, has launched an Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol that delivers 750 tokens per second with no loss in quality. The underlying hardware uses a wafer-scale engine with 44GB of SRAM integrated on the chip, reducing data movement and overcoming the memory bottleneck typical of GPUs.

Benchmark results show that completing all 2,500 questions from the Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), Ultrafast takes only 11 hours, while Claude Fable 5 takes 78 hours — roughly seven times faster. On the GDP-Val economic value task, it achieves a 5.6x end-to-end speedup with unchanged quality.
